item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.title: US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
item.description: Fossil fuels are still the biggest source of electricity for hyperscale data centers in the US, a new paper published in the journal Nature Sustainability shows. They likely burn through more electricity collectively than many countries do, resulting in a serious amount of greenhouse gas emissions.

item.title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
item.description: ChatGPT will ban an account trying to access CSAM content for 24 hours as a warning.

item.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
item.description: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, but restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about their independence.

item.title: Jordan Belfort’s new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the ‘Wolf of Wall Street’
item.description: Belfort claims his AI sales voice can already close deals almost as well as the best human salespeople, and he thinks it will catch up in a year.

item.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
item.description: The FBI says that the open source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.

item.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.

item.title: Tesla goes all-in on the Cybercab with upcoming €3B Berlin gigafactory expansion
item.description: Tesla is putting Europe on its Cybercab roadmap with a €3 billion expansion of its Berlin gigafactory.

item.title: Island is a new screen-time app that turns staying off your phone into a game
item.description: YC-backed Island turns screen time goals into a farming game, rewarding users with new crops, animals, and more when they stick to their limits.

item.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
item.description: Trump contradicted his own government's intelligence officials, who reportedly concluded that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy.

item.title: Apple adds ‘face unlock’ to the iPhone Duo, but it’s not Face ID
item.description: Apple's latest iOS 27.3 developer beta introduces a limited face unlock feature for the iPhone Duo, alongside other improvements.

item.title: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver’s licenses during data breach
item.description: The ride-sharing giant said driver's license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.

item.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
item.description: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

item.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
item.description: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.

item.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
item.description: Nvidia interim CEO and longtime CFO Colette Kress is about to have one of the biggest days of her career on Tuesday when the company reports its third-quarter results. Given the turmoil Nvidia is in, there are a number of questions that Nvidia should answer.

item.title: Cyber giant Infoblox confirms security incident after hackers access ‘company information’
item.description: The cybersecurity and automation giant said it's working with outside investigators to understand the scale of the breach.

item.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
item.description: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.
